---
title: "Automated checks"
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
# The text below is tests/README.md, included so there is one copy to maintain.
include_md <- function(path, base) {
  x <- readLines(path, encoding = "UTF-8", warn = FALSE)
  if (length(x) && grepl("^# ", x[1])) x <- x[-1]          # the article has its own title
  x <- gsub("\\]\\((?!https?://|#)([^)]+)\\)", paste0("](", base, "\\1)"), x, perl = TRUE)
  knitr::asis_output(paste(x, collapse = "\n"))
}
```

```{r, echo = FALSE}
include_md("../../tests/README.md", "https://github.com/immunoplex/i-spi-deployment/blob/main/tests/")
```

A fourth workflow, `.github/workflows/pkgdown.yml`, builds this site on every
pull request and publishes it from `main`.
